text:
I'll implement the four stub functions with stdlib-only, Python 3.8-compatible code, keeping `fetch`/`save` untouched.
Implemented all four stubs in `tools/web_probe.py:39` (plus `_FieldParser` / session helpers); `fetch` and `save` untouched. Tests pass (131 OK) and the file parses under Python 3.8.

- `list_fields` — parses form controls (hidden tokens, text/password, checked checkbox/radio, select, textarea) and exposes `_action` / `_method`.
- `build_request` — merges field overrides, supports `url` / `method` / `headers` control keys, urlencodes the body and folds it into the query for GET/HEAD.
- `replay` — sends through a cookie-backed session, returns status/headers/body, and captures HTTP/URL errors instead of raising.
- `run_batch` — replays a mixed list of overrides dicts, `(fields, overrides)` pairs, or URLs, writing `evidence/batch_results.json`.
